original_question: (M. Tărnăuceanu). Is it true that for every positive rational number r there exists a finite group G such that | Aut(G)|/|G| = r? A similar question is answered in the positive for graphs, monoids, partial groups, and posets(R. Molinier, Preprint, 2025, https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.21059). It is also known that the set {| Aut(G)|/|G| | G is a finite abelian group} is dense in [0, +∞) (M. Tărnăuceanu, Elemente Math. (2025), https://ems.press/journals/ em/articles/14298544).
target_in_paper: Problem 21.97 in the section "New Problems (21st issue, 2026)": "(M. Tărnăuceanu). Is it true that for every positive rational number r there exists a finite group G such that |Aut(G)|/|G| = r?"
correct_elements: The draft already matches the paper extremely closely: it states the exact quantifier over positive rational numbers, asks for existence of a finite group G, uses the correct invariant |Aut(G)|/|G|, and includes the two contextual remarks that appear immediately after the problem in the paper.
missing_details: To make it fully stand-alone, say explicitly that Aut(G) denotes the full automorphism group of the finite group G.
For exact paper-faithfulness, identify the source as Problem 21.97 in the section "New Problems (21st issue, 2026)".
If attribution is retained, the entry is printed as "(M. Tărnăuceanu)" and closes with "R. Molinier."
refined_question: For every positive rational number r in Q_{>0}, does there exist a finite group G such that |Aut(G)|/|G| = r, where Aut(G) denotes the automorphism group of G?
justification: The paper's official formulation is already essentially your draft verbatim. Problem 21.97 asks exactly whether every positive rational number occurs as the ratio |Aut(G)|/|G| for some finite group G, and the same entry records the analogous realization result for graphs, monoids, partial groups, and posets, as well as the density result for finite abelian groups. There is no narrower reformulation or proved equivalent variant supplied nearby in the paper, so the sharpest paper-faithful rewrite is simply the official question with the standard notation Aut(G) made explicit.
